rationale: Describes a mainframe service-order provisioning system that assigns outside and central-office facilities and maintains related inventories.
evidence_spans: FACS is a mainframe application used to provision service orders.
LFACS - contains the outside plant inventory (includes cable and pair) SOAC - monitors and controls the service order flow SWITCH - contains the central office inventory (includes office equipment).
assigns outside facilities (cable pair) as well as inside facilities (central office equipment).
